issues.problem: The edition prints 'śāśvatīṃ' (f. acc. sg.), but the draft silently changes the word to 'śāśvatīḥ' (acc. pl.) with no text_flags entry. That is the well-known variant 'śāśvatīḥ samāḥ', not what this witness reads. The printed form is grammatical: śāśvatīm qualifies pratiṣṭhām ('everlasting repose'), and samāḥ is an accusative of duration ('for years'). Either keep the printed reading in `words` or add a text_flags entry; a silent change is not allowed.

issues.problem: Wrong count stated as fact. Each pāda has 12 syllables: u-dā-ra-vṛt-tār-tha-pa-dair-ma-no-ra-mais (12), ta-dā-sya-rā-ma-sya-ca-kā-ra-kīr-ti-mān (12), sa-mā-kṣa-raiḥ-ślo-ka-śa-tair-ya-śas-vi-no (12), ya-śas-ka-raṃ-kā-vya-mu-dā-ra-dhīr-mu-niḥ (12). This is a jagatī-class metre (vaṃśastha/indravaṃśā type), not an 11-syllable triṣṭubh.
issues.fix: Closing verse in a longer metre with 12-syllable pādas (jagatī class).

summary: 41 units checked; tokens match the printed text throughout and most splits, glosses and case labels are sound. 2 errors: unit 14 silently replaces the printed 'śāśvatīṃ' with the variant 'śāśvatīḥ' (no text_flags; the printed singular is grammatical with pratiṣṭhām), and unit 41's note miscounts the metre as 11-syllable pādas (they are 12). 25 minor issues: small additions in the translations (unit 6 'me', 8/9/16 added 'मुनि', 12 'हृदय में', 21 'yet/भी...ही', 26 'Even' and tadā rendered as 'there', 27 'बड़ा'), 'ekam' dropped/misplaced in unit 10, weak gloss of cintā (15), compound-type labels for mahā-prājña (16) and akṣara-sama (17), 'samanvita' glossed 'fit for' (17), an unrecorded alternative construal of guroḥ (20), an imported commentator claim in unit 32's note, a missing text_flags entry for 'rāma kathāṃ' (34), and a note on the epic gerund āpṛṣṭvā (2). Confidence levels are honest (3 and 32 at medium are right). No regrouping suggested: the edition's verse grouping is kept, and the sentence running across 32-33 is already noted in both units.
